claim_boundary: For the full label-preserving diagonal family J_c, all 225 target two-by-two minor pullbacks lie in the rank-one source ideal exactly when the corresponding 225 c-minors vanish. This supplies neither c nor a source interface, target-minor identity, AFK, fusion, Stark, or TCC.

companion_decision.evidence_scope_review: The complete result is suitable only as the full 225-minor coordinate-ring pullback criterion for label-preserving diagonal maps.
companion_decision.falsifier: Any determinantal-ideal, pullback formula, monomial nonvanishing modulo the rank-one ideal, 225-minor census, A6 label action, or replay discrepancy invalidates the seal.
companion_decision.known_flaw: The criterion is conditional and supplies no source-authorized coefficients c, no actual J, no target-minor vanishing, and no projective amplitude equality; A6 contributes no coefficient determination because it fixes every label mod 6.
companion_decision.next_action: Open a distinct cycle freezing a source-derived equation-(66) or translation-covariant construction of c; use c_(a,b)=r_a*s_b, derive r_a and s_b without endpoint fitting, then test the resulting J against the full labeled C198 projective target.
companion_decision.reason: The exact reduction, all-ones rank-one nonmembership witness, and complete A6 census establish the stated criterion while the companion keeps every coefficient construction and target equality outside its boundary.
companion_decision.recommendation: Seal C208/B045 as PROVED only for the full 225-minor coordinate-ring pullback criterion for label-preserving diagonal maps.
